title: JVM heaps and stacks count trace event state
description: Shape of the `state` field for jvm-heaps-stacks-count trace events: the single shared heap plus one frame stack per live thread, emitted by the visual.VisualRuntimeAreas model.

heapCount.description: Number of heaps in this JVM instance. Always 1.

stackCount.description: Number of live thread stacks (one per live thread).

stacks.description: One call stack per live thread, in thread-start order.

thread.description: thread name, e.g. main or worker-1

frames.description: this thread's frames, bottom frame first

heap.description: Objects in the single shared heap, in allocation order.

owner.description: thread that ran new (the object is still shared)
